name: 无感超薄液体卫生巾日夜款
description: 无感贴合、透气轻盈、日夜安心的卫生巾套图模版

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale mint #DDEDE5 and warm coral #F4C9BC gradients for info and scene screens, deep pine green #1E5B4A only as accent bands
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front or upper-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte rounded plinths and soft matte panels, smooth untextured backdrops
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line rounded icons, single deep pine green accent
styleLock.presentationRules: stable centered product placement, gentle S-curve stance for hero shots, consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft feminine care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale mint #DDEDE5, warm coral #F4C9BC with deep pine green #1E5B4A as the only accent; bright soft diffused studio lighting with gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line rounded icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable centered product placement and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, pad lying flat and centered, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: generous clean margin around the product for marketplace cropping
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pad lying flat and centered, photographed straight-on at eye-level with its full silhouette visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, generous negative space kept clean around it for marketplace cropping. 8K, commercial ecommerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no model, no watermark, no fake logo, no certification marks, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达无感轻盈的核心卖点，建立主视觉记忆
shots.camera: pad standing upright in a gentle S-curve on a rounded plinth, camera placed just beneath the top edge and tilted upward for a heroic stance
shots.lighting: soft diffused key light from the upper left, gentle fill, soft contact shadow
shots.background: pale mint #DDEDE5 with a deep pine green #1E5B4A headline band at the top
shots.whitespace: clean negative space on the upper left 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pad standing upright in a gentle S-curve on a rounded matte plinth, camera placed just beneath the top edge and tilted upward for a heroic stance. Soft diffused key light from the upper left with gentle fill, soft contact shadow. Background pale mint #DDEDE5 with a deep pine green #1E5B4A headline band at the top reading 「{selling_point_1}」. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, clean negative space on the upper left 40% for copy. Negative: no absorbency numbers, no leakage-duration claims, no material composition claims, no brand logos, no model, no garbled characters, no watermark, no fake certification marks.

shots.intent: 放大普通卫生巾厚硬闷热的痛点，衬托本品的轻薄柔软
shots.camera: two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level framing
shots.lighting: left panel flat harsh light, right panel soft even light, consistent camera on both sides
shots.background: warm coral #F4C9BC on both panels with a deep pine green #1E5B4A headline strip
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the two states fill the panels
shots.textZone: one short label 「{selling_point_2}」 above each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level framing. Left panel: an unbranded ordinary pad looking bulky, wrinkled and stiff under flat harsh light, conveying stuffiness. Right panel: {product} lying relaxed and smooth in soft even light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background warm coral #F4C9BC on both panels, a deep pine green #1E5B4A headline strip at the top with 「{selling_point_2}」 above each panel. Each pad occupies 45-50% of its panel, no extra whitespace. Negative: no real model or body parts, no leakage or stain imagery, no fabricated test data or statistics, no brand names, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用引导线讲清结构分区，消除结构疑虑且不承诺数值
shots.camera: pad vertical and centered, photographed straight-on at eye-level with four thin leader lines
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: soft blush pink #F7E3DD with one white rounded info card
shots.props: one white rounded info card and thin leader lines
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 45% for the label column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce feature infographic of {product}, the pad vertical and centered, photographed straight-on at eye-level with four thin leader lines pointing to labeled zones. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow. Background soft blush pink #F7E3DD with one white rounded info card. Four short labels rendered as 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in deep pine green #1E5B4A, each an empty value slot left for post compositing. The pad occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space on the right 45% for the label column. Negative: no dimension numbers, no thickness values, no absorbency or anti-leak claims, no certification text, no dense body copy, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以微距质感证明面层细腻透气，建立品质信任
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro shot from directly overhead, tight zoom on the perforated top sheet and the soft mint core strip, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming light from the left revealing fine perforation texture, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom from directly overhead on the perforated top sheet and the soft mint core strip. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground fibers sharp. Skimming light from the left revealing the fine perforation texture, controlled highlight. Background light mint #E4F1EA. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace since the texture is the subject. One small corner label 「{callout_5}」 in deep pine green #1E5B4A. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material claims, no counts of holes or fibers, no extra text, no watermark, no hands.

shots.intent: 代入睡眠与出行场景，让买家自我投射安心感
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel, product at the edge of a soft bedding corner
shots.lighting: warm morning window light from the left, gentle shadow falloff, soft contact shadow
shots.background: warm coral #F4C9BC gradient wall with two pale mint #DDEDE5 side panels
shots.props: a folded blanket corner and a small travel pouch, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 45% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} tucked at the edge of a soft bedding corner beside a small travel pouch. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel. Warm morning window light from the left, gentle shadow falloff, soft contact shadow. Background warm coral #F4C9BC gradient wall with two pale mint #DDEDE5 side panels reading 「{selling_point_3}」 and 「{selling_point_4}」. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, generous negative space on the left 45% for copy. Negative: no recognizable face, no model body close-up, no hands covering the product, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no messy clutter.

shots.intent: 用问答版式回应疑虑，空白答案位避免编造资质
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level flat infographic screen, three stacked white rounded question cards
shots.background: soft blush #F9EDE8 with a deep pine green #1E5B4A header band
shots.props: three white rounded Q&A cards with empty answer slots
shots.whitespace: generous negative space between the cards
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce FAQ trust screen for {product}, straight-on eye-level flat infographic with three stacked white rounded question cards. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting. Background soft blush #F9EDE8 with a deep pine green #1E5B4A header band reading 「{selling_point_5}」. Each card carries a short question line 「{callout_6}」 and an empty answer slot left blank for post compositing. The product thumbnail occupies 45-55% overall, generous negative space between the cards. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, approvals, test reports or standards numbers, no dense paragraphs, no QR codes, no membership badges, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 日夜组合收口促单，给出明确的行动按钮
shots.camera: slight 3/4 group shot, a day pack and a night pack side by side with identical lighting
shots.lighting: soft punchy studio light from the front-left, soft contact shadows
shots.background: deep pine green #1E5B4A with a warm coral #F4C9BC arc
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}, a day pack and a night pack side by side at a slight 3/4 angle with identical lighting. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft punchy studio light from the front-left, soft contact shadows. Background deep pine green #1E5B4A with a warm coral #F4C9BC arc and a CTA button reading 「{callout_7}」. The group occupies 55-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no spec numbers, no brand logos, no QR codes, no watermark, no garbled characters.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 主视觉=斜立于弧形台面的卫生巾、薄荷绿芯条、竖纹与干草道具、卖点标题；P2 上为干草与粉石台、下为粉底三张浅绿卡片（卡内为空白图位）；P3 粉色渐变+深绿头带+金边问答卡+半透明蓝色渲染巾体；P4 立式巾体四点引导线标注；P5 浅绿底轻/透/薄三圆标+斜置巾体；P6/P7 生活场景（模特弯腰拉伸、帽遮面部）配睡觉穿/运动穿/旅行穿浅绿面板；P7-P8 常见问答复选卡。品类判定：源夹名「洗护」与品类不符，按图硬证据改判——页面品名为「液体卫生巾」、问答区自述为卫生巾类产品，属个护用品，判为护肤个护/女性护理（taxonomy 无卫生巾专设类目，leaf 取自由文本「液体卫生巾日夜组合」）。已剥离与留白：品牌 LOGO 与全部字标、原文案原句、二维码与加入会员/全店免费角标、欧美进口来源表述、境外监管机构批准与符合标准等全部资质表述（来源页自述，不可核验）、Flexfoam/FLEXFORM 材质名（源页拼写自相矛盾）一律不写入；吸收量与防漏时长类断言（反锁海量、一吸到底、吸后极薄、百次挤压不变形、透气孔数量）仅以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 留白占位；厚度数值两屏互相矛盾（0.4cm 与 0.08cm），两种均不作为事实写入，换为空白标注槽；绵柔/网面等面层材质断言未写入，仅作中性视觉描述；模特不出现可辨识面容（仅远景背影式构图）；全部产品以 {product} 占位，场景、构图、光位、色板为可复用部分。
